# Google Accounts

> Central hub for Google Account management, authentication, and legal agreements governing Google services.

Google Accounts is the primary authentication and account management platform for all Google services. This site handles user account creation, security, recovery, and the legal terms that govern the use of Google products and services.

## Key Topics

- Google Account
- Terms of Service
- Privacy Policy
- Legal Agreement
- User Rights
- Service Terms
- Account Agreement
- Google LLC
- Google Services
- Authentication

## Legal & Terms

- [Google Terms of Service](https://accounts.google.com/TOS): Google's Terms of Service and legal agreement for Google Account users
